verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several in-product AI features drawn from the user's own data. Ask AI generates answers to questions like "when is my flight" from the inbox, Auto Labels classify incoming mail by importance, and Auto Drafts suggest replies using context from the inbox, calendar and web. Follow-up reminders and calendar context surface automatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features (community items don't discuss them), and explicit in-product summary or analytics-style insights (thread summarization is documented only via the external MCP route); custom AI labels are also limited to Business/Enterprise.
